name: Minisatip
tagline: A multi-threaded satip server version 1. 2 that runs under Linux and it was tested with DVB-S, DVB-S2, DVB-T, DVB-T2, DVB-C, DVB-C2, ATSC and ISDB-T cards.
description: Minisatip is a multi-threaded satip server version 1.2 that runs under Linux and it was tested with DVB-S, DVB-S2, DVB-T, DVB-T2, DVB-C, DVB-C2, ATSC and ISDB-T cards.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/minisatip:2.0.103@sha256:3ff7892f3cdf3fa3dd0f90f526fb345837febf86b8f11d8f680ec09612fbc6f2
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      RUN_OPTS: ''
    ports:
      - target: 8875
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 554
        published: 554
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 1900
        published: 1900
        protocol: udp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
